Keep training before evaluation

In forecasting, a shuffled split can allow future observations into training. Sort by time and validate against later observations. TimeSeriesSplit expands training windows and can leave a gap before evaluation. Standard folds assume evenly spaced observations for comparable time intervals.

import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import TimeSeriesSplit

rows = np.arange(8)
for train, test in TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=2, test_size=2, gap=1).split(rows):
    print(train[-1], test[0])

Keep each entity in one fold at a time

If several rows share a customer, order, or session, group by that entity. GroupKFold keeps test groups disjoint from train groups in each split. Choose the group that matches what will be new at prediction time.
